explore-the-context-window.notes: Page title and intro blurb. Sets up the interactive simulation concept.

jsx-component-events-data.notes: The bulk of the file is JSX/React source for the ContextWindow simulation component. Contains embedded desc strings documenting: auto memory 200-line/25KB limit, MCP deferred schema loading (ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH), skill descriptions not surviving /compact, hooks additionalContext mechanism, subagent separate context isolation, PostToolUse hook exit-code-2 behavior, /compact summarization. Not user-facing prose; data embedded in component.

claude-code-s-context-window-holds.notes: Introductory prose paragraph before the ContextWindow component. Describes what the context window contains.

what-the-timeline-shows.notes: Section summarizing what the interactive timeline covers: startup loading, file reads, path-scoped rules, PostToolUse hooks, subagent isolation, /compact.

what-survives-compaction.notes: Core compaction survival table: system prompt unchanged, CLAUDE.md re-injected, auto memory re-injected, path-scoped rules lost until trigger file re-read, nested CLAUDE.md lost until re-read, invoked skill bodies re-injected (5K/skill cap, 25K total), hooks not applicable. Critical reference.

path-scoped-rules-and-nested-claude-md.notes: Explains why path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md are lost after compaction: they load into message history, not outside it. Workaround: drop paths: frontmatter or move to project-root CLAUDE.md.

skill-bodies-are-re-injected.notes: Skill bodies re-injected after compaction but truncated to 5K per skill / 25K total. Oldest invoked skills dropped first. Instructions: put critical content near top of SKILL.md.

check-your-own-session.notes: Points to /context command for live usage breakdown and /memory to verify loaded files.

related-resources.notes: Navigation links to features-overview, memory, sub-agents, best-practices, costs pages.
